reviews.author: Alicia Finley
reviews.text: Noah offered me his help even though I am typically out of his service area. He knew I really needed the help shoveling because my body doesn't allow for me to do certain physical activity. He is really acknowledgable about his craft. The guy who plows my driveway makes it harder when it comes to shoveling because snow is building up making my driveway and pathways smaller. Noah gave me advice and now I can have a conversation and better game plan with my plower. Noah and his team are coming back to do more shoveling for me tomorrow and I am excited to come home from work and find more areas that I can finally get access to. I highly reccomend Noah. He gladly gets the job done! Thank you, Noah!!!
reviews.owner_response: Thank you so much for the kind review Alicia! We are happy to help!

reviews.author: Wendy Elkins
reviews.text: Noah and his team did a great job of mowing my overgrown yard and weed whacking. A BIG thank you ! Very reasonable pricing too! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mary Beth Thomas
reviews.text: I contacted Noah in a pinch for a one time plow after a recent storm. He was amazing to deal with. He was fast, courteous and helpful. He was able to fit me in on short notice and help. Thank YOU!!
reviews.owner_response: Thank you so much Mary Beth! We are happy to help!

reviews.author: Kathy Jochim
reviews.text: This winter came early and it has snowed a lot already. My initial plans for snow removal didn’t happen and I was in a bind. I needed my driveway cleared as soon as possible. A friend recommended Noah. Noah was quick to answer my call and came up to my house just as quickly. He did a great job and came right back out after it snowed a bunch again. His rates are reasonable, he is conscientious, and his work is good.
reviews.owner_response: Thank you Kathy! We were glad to help!

reviews.author: Holly
reviews.text:
Noah and his staff were very professional. He returns my text or phone calls.
I find Noah to be extremely professional, knowledgeable and courteous. We did walk-throughs of the needed work, he would give a price quote and stuck to it. The work itself ( a large backyard flower garden) exceeded my expectations! Beautiful work. He kept me in the loop throughout his job, and when done cleaned up and took away all dead, and/or mowed clippings and weeds. Excellent!!

reviews.author: Michael Pelkey
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Noah and his team for helping me out in a time of need. My lawn mower broke down and my lawn got very overgrown. I had lawn services no quote me because it was so overgrown. Called Noah and he showed up to my house immediately and had it done before I knew it. Since then Noah and his crew have been maintaining my lawn and I couldn't be happier. Thank you Noah a million times over!!!

reviews.author: Don Fox
reviews.text: Contacted Noah to come and weed our overgrown 15' x 30' vegetable garden. He responded very quickly and came out and provided an estimate on the same day. They were able to weed, place fabric, and match and place about 2" of river stone within about 4 hours. Very happy with their work.
